confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'an open circuit reading confirms the heating element is broken internally' and 'a replacement heating element costs around £30–£40' when the heater is part of the circulation heat pump assembly

rationale: The assistant took the customer's open-circuit result as confirming a failed heater, which is right in direction. It wrongly treated the heater as a cheap separate element at £30-£40, when the fix is a heat pump assembly that costs more, and it described the test as being on a tub-bottom element. The answers were also truncated several times and the final reply was thin. It gave no real repair-vs-replace guidance and no warning that pump replacement is advanced DIY.
